critical.issue: Returns 500. Root cause: Firestore FailedPrecondition - collection-group `walletHistory` requires an explicit COLLECTION_GROUP index on field `type` (single-field indexes do NOT cover collectionGroup filters, contrary to what /app/FIRESTORE_INDEXES.md claims). Fix: create the collectionGroup index (Firebase gave a one-click console link in the error) OR wrap firestore_repo._fetch() in try/except google.api_core.exceptions.FailedPrecondition and return [] with a logger.warning so the UI degrades gracefully.

minor.issue: If the caller passes a Firestore-reserved id (e.g. starts and ends with `__`, like `__DOES_NOT_EXIST__`), Firestore raises InvalidArgument and the server returns 500 instead of 404. Not exploitable but should be a defensive 404. Consider validating item_id or catching InvalidArgument in get_module_doc().

Doc incorrectly states walletHistory collection-group filters need no index. In practice `collection_group('walletHistory').where('type','==',...)` requires an explicit collectionGroup index; update the doc and add it to firestore.indexes.json.

rca of the issue: Backend 500s on payments/conversions/withdrawals: Firestore requires an explicit collection-group index for `collection_group('walletHistory').where(FieldFilter('type','==','topup'))` etc. The auto-created single-field index only supports queries on a specific collection, not the collection-group scope. The code in firestore_repo._fetch() imports FailedPrecondition + InvalidArgument but never catches them, so the exception propagates to a 500. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' <base>/api/resources/payments` -> 500; server log shows `google.api_core.exceptions.FailedPrecondition: 400 The query requires a COLLECTION_GROUP_ASC index for collection walletHistory and field type. You can create it here: https://console.firebase.google.com/v1/r/project/earn2love-app/firestore/indexes?create_exemption=...`. Mitigation: (a) open the Firebase console one-click link from the error to create the collectionGroup index on walletHistory.type (fastest, correct fix); or (b) wrap `q.limit(CAP).stream()` in try/except FailedPrecondition in firestore_repo._fetch() returning [] so the UI shows an empty state; (c) also update /app/FIRESTORE_INDEXES.md which is incorrect.
